# Evaluation Snapshot

## Prompt

Run the ordinary unit tests for this local helper; no artifact class,
provenance, signature, registry evidence, or consumer trust gate is involved.

## Expected selection

do_not_use

## Why

An ordinary local validation task has no artifact-trust admission pressure and
does not need the OS Abyss trust loop.

## Expected object

Decision: do_not_use `os-abyss-artifact-trust-loop`. Use the ordinary local
test route because no artifact-trust or consumer-gate pressure exists.

## Boundary notes

Do not widen routine unit testing into provenance, signing, registry, or host
trust work merely because the repository belongs to the broader ecosystem.

## Verification hooks

The response should keep the trust skill out of the route and use the nearest
local test owner without adding artifact, registry, or promotion claims.
